raw_text: Philippine Navy sources confirm CCG water cannon attack on resupply mission to BRP Sierra Madre at Ayungin Shoal. Crew members report damage to supply boats and minor injuries. Videos from onboard show high-pressure water streams hitting the vessels at close range. This is the most aggressive Chinese action this year.
